A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
